in_marathi.name: Satis
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity and Wife of Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satis हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satis is the goddess of fertility, marriage, prosperity, and chastity. She is the wife of Lord Shiva and is known as Parvati. Satis is also the embodiment of Shakti, the divine feminine energy.
